_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Preparation of Final Inspection Record
summary: The Final Inspection Record establishes and classifies quality characteristics for final examination and functional testing of major end items and components, serving as a permanent record of final inspection results for system level vehicles and major end items.
use_relationship: Establishes and classifies quality characteristics for final examination and functional testing of major end items and components. Serves as a permanent record of final inspection results of system level vehicles and major end items. The FIR is a contractual document which sets forth the minimum inspection characteristic determined necessary to assure conformance to end item specifications and drawings. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation. This DID superseded DI-QCIC-81068.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference documents.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Final Inspection Record (FIR) shall be prepared for recording inspection results. The format of the FIR shall be organized so as to be compatible with assemblies, installations, and end item performance and acceptance requirements.

preparation_instructions.title: General.
preparation_instructions.content:
It is intended that the FIR be developed in the same sequence that the major assemblies and all subassemblies, major systems, or subsystems are to be inspected. In any event, any characteristics that cannot be inspected after final assembly shall be inspected as the item is assembled during the normal manufacturing process. This does not preclude the contractor from changes in sequence to satisfy the inspection program. At the discretion of the procuring activity, the FIR may also include characteristics that are to be inspected and recorded during in-process manufacturing/assembly operations.

The FIR shall be prepared and maintained current with the Quality Conformance Inspection (QCI) and Control Test (CT) requirements set forth in the engineering drawings and vehicle/end item specification requirements.
